advisory.summary: ENG-24: the import-following loop calls warm(...) without hold, so import targets are held up to BLOB_CAP each outside CONFIG_BUDGET. One import hop from a config-included file gets around the new 16 MiB budget. The path existed before this change and is bounded by the @path lines in included files and by IMPORT_HOPS.
advisory.fix: Pass the remaining budget to the import-loop warm call and subtract what it returns, so config and import targets share one total. Index targets past the budget unparsed with the existing note. Add a test with CONFIG_BUDGET patched small where an included file imports a file that is not config-matched.
